evidence: Modifies libbitcoinkernel public C API headers, implementations, and C++ wrapper (src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{h,cpp}) to route logging connections through contexts.
rationale: Establishes logging connection interfaces on context creation to prevent future breaking API changes and unblock per-context logging in #30342. The author notes that without this API hook, 'future per-context routing would force breaking API changes and caller restructuring' across all kernel consumers and bindings.
